slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: 第十七章杂役堂
云船在云海之中飞驰了半刻钟时间。
“到了，徐长老的飞云，速度太快了，仅仅半刻钟的时间，就飞跃千里。”
其中一位剑阁弟子，看着远处那座如剑一般的巨峰，笑着开口说道。
“废话，飞云可是五阶灵器。”
“这次本来应该是徐执事前去处理矿坑之事的，但是恰好他前往皇城处理事务，徐长老才替他前来的，不然你以为我们会有机会坐上这飞云吗？”
“说的也是，若不是这飞云，某人此时估计已经成为寒阴地龙的腹中食了。”
那几位青年男女，看着远处的巨峰，随后又看向方羽，纷纷轻笑着开口说道。
方羽听到之后，面色不改，而是看向远处那巨峰。
巨峰矗立于山脉之间，周围层峦叠嶂，云雾笼罩着半山腰，令方羽看不清这巨峰到底有多高。
在巨峰的周围，还有七座稍小的山峰环绕，拱卫着中央的巨峰，仿佛在守卫一般。
就在此时，徐元推开船舱的门，走了出来。
随着徐元走出，众多剑阁弟子，也收敛了笑容。
徐元一挥手，那云船犹如利剑一般，朝着远处的巨峰飞射而去。
仅仅几个呼吸的时间，云船就稳稳当当的停在山脚下。
方羽看着不远处的山门，准确来说，是看着山门中央的一块石碑。
石碑上书写着剑阁二字。
但是方羽看着这两个字，却感觉这根本不是字，而是两柄剑，两柄直破云霄的利剑。
看了几个呼吸，方羽就感觉到双目干涩，隐隐有些刺痛。
随后方羽收回目光，目光落在石碑前。
在石碑前，居然插着一柄无鞘长剑，剑通体黝黑，剑身布满了铁锈，那黑色的剑柄也不知道是污垢还是，本来材质就是如此。
方羽看着这柄剑，心中却不知为何升起别样的感觉。
“那两个字，不是如今的你能够看的，看久了，你眼睛会瞎的，下船，别愣着了。”
就在方羽愣神之际，刚才跟方羽搭话的那位少女，不知何时来到方羽身侧，对着方羽催促道。
方羽回过神来，发现其余人都已然在船下，当下身形一动，跟着少女一跃而下。
徐元挥手间，将飞云收起，随后看了一眼方羽，对着周围几位剑阁弟子开口说道。
“你们带方羽去杂役堂报到。”
说罢之后，徐元就朝着山门内走去，每一步都跨越数丈之远，转眼间就消失在山门尽头。
“我还有事先走了。”
其中一位青年男子，看了一眼方羽，随后开口说道，说罢之后朝着山门走去。

Chapter 17 Handyman Hall
The cloud boat flew through the sea of clouds for half an hour.
"Here we are, Elder Xu's Feiyun is so fast. It can fly thousands of miles in just half a quarter of an hour."
One of the sword pavilion disciples looked at the giant sword-like peak in the distance and said with a smile.
"Nonsense, Feiyun is a fifth-level spiritual weapon."
"Deacon Xu was supposed to go to deal with the mine this time, but it happened that he went to the imperial city to deal with matters, and Elder Xu came here on his behalf. Otherwise, do you think we would have a chance to ride on this Feiyun?"
"That's right. If it weren't for Feiyun, someone would have become the food of the Hanyin Earth Dragon."
...
The young men and women looked at the giant peak in the distance, then looked at Fang Yu, and they all chuckled and said.
After Fang Yu heard this, his expression did not change, but he looked towards the giant peak in the distance.
The giant peak stands among the mountains, surrounded by mountains and mountains. Clouds and mist cover the mountainside, making it difficult for Fang Yu to see how high the giant peak is.
Around the giant peak, there are seven smaller peaks surrounding it, guarding the central giant peak as if on guard.
At this moment, Xu Yuan pushed open the cabin door and walked out.
As Xu Yuan walked out, many Jiange disciples also stopped smiling.
Xu Yuan waved his hand, and the cloud ship flew towards the giant peak in the distance like a sharp sword.
In just a few breaths, the cloud boat stopped steadily at the foot of the mountain.
Fang Yu looked at the mountain gate not far away. To be precise, he looked at a stone tablet in the center of the mountain gate.
The word "Jiange" is written on the stone tablet.
But when Fang Yu looked at these two words, he felt that they were not words at all, but two swords, two sharp swords that cut through the sky.
After taking a few breaths, Fang Yu felt his eyes were dry and slightly tingling.
Then Fang Yu withdrew his gaze and landed in front of the stone tablet.
In front of the stone monument, there was an unsheathed long sword. The sword was completely black, and the sword body was covered with rust. I don't know if the black hilt was dirt or the original material.
Fang Yu looked at the sword, but for some reason he felt a different feeling in his heart.
"Those two words are not something you can read now. If you look at them for too long, you will go blind. Get off the boat and stop being stunned."
Just when Fang Yu was stunned, the girl who had just spoken to Fang Yu came to Fang Yu's side at some point and urged Fang Yu.
"Oh."
Fang Yu came back to his senses and found that the others were already under the boat. He immediately moved and jumped off after the girl.
Xu Yuan put away Feiyun with a wave of his hand, then glanced at Fang Yu and spoke to several Jiange disciples around him.
"Take Fang Yu to report to the handyman hall."
After saying that, Xu Yuan walked towards the mountain gate, covering several feet with each step, and disappeared at the end of the mountain gate in the blink of an eye.
"I have to leave first."
One of the young men glanced at Fang Yu, then spoke, and then walked towards the mountain gate.
